# GitHub Copilot Instructions — APP-SPJ

Before editing this repository, read and follow:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `.ai/rules/index.md`
- `docs/README.md`
- `docs/DOCUMENTATION_MAINTENANCE.md`
- `docs/CURRENT_PROGRESS.md`
- `docs/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md`
- relevant domain/feature documentation

Mandatory completion rule:

- perform a **Documentation Impact Review** before considering a task complete;
- update impacted docs in the same change when behavior, architecture, status, workflow, or evidence changes;
- never hard-code current project priority here; derive it from `CURRENT_PROGRESS.md` and `DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md`;
- never claim tests, CI, browser, runtime, or real-data verification without actual evidence;
- stale documentation is a defect;
- if no documentation changes are needed, still verify that existing docs remain accurate.

The canonical documentation-governance policy is `docs/DOCUMENTATION_MAINTENANCE.md`.
